item.title: Show HN: Linksh.re, a link shortener with no signup, just a recovery code
item.summary: Every link shortener makes you sign up before you get anything. Mine doesn't. Paste a URL, get your short link, done. No account, no email, no password. You get a one-time recovery code instead, shown once. Lose the link, come back later, get your links back with the code. Want more than a link? Build a bio page instead, one page for all your links and socials (needs a real account for that one). Point your own domain at either. Every link gets a QR code too. Built on Cloudflare Workers: vinext, Neon Postgres behind Hyperdrive, Cloudflare for SaaS for custom domains, Better Auth, Polar for billing. Live at linksh.re Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49194224 Points: 1 # Comments: 1
